title:
HF3227 (2019-2020 Regular): Firearms; providing that a person may not be denied the right to\r
purchase, own, possess, or carry a firearm solely on the basis that the person is\r
enrolled as a patient in the medical cannabis registry.

other_topics: cannabis-policy: Section 8 (Minn. Stat. 624.7152) and Section 5 — limits on use of the medical cannabis patient registry and patient status in gun decisions

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/91/2020/0/HF/3227/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version (no date in file). Also adds definitions (Sections 1-3), makes a carry permit holder who is a registry patient and knows the cannabis can impair unable to carry a pistol in public (Section 6, new clause 7), and requires application forms to let patients leave out medical cannabis use (Section 7). Multi verdict is a judgement call: the whole bill ties gun rights to cannabis registry status.

operative_text:
Section 4 (Minn. Stat. 624.713, subd. 1): Participation as a patient in the medical cannabis registry under sections 152.22 to 152.37 does not disqualify the person from possessing firearms and ammunition under this section.
Section 5 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 6): A sheriff shall not deny an application for a permit to carry solely because the applicant is a patient enrolled in the medical cannabis registry under sections 152.22 to 152.37 and uses medical cannabis for a qualifying medical condition.
Section 8 (Minn. Stat. 624.7152, new): A person may not be denied the right to purchase, own, possess, or carry a firearm solely on the basis that the person is a qualifying patient.
Section 8 (Minn. Stat. 624.7152, new): A state or local agency may not access a database containing the identities of qualifying patients to obtain information for the purpose of approving or disapproving a person from purchasing, owning, possessing, or carrying a firearm.
Section 8 (Minn. Stat. 624.7152, new): A state or local agency may not inquire about a person's status as a qualifying patient for the purpose of approving or disapproving the person from purchasing, owning, possessing, or carrying a firearm.
